tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sdug kun nyes pa'i skyon bral dam pa'i chos/ /de nyid tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad dge 'dun te/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ / bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag po a ti sha /rgyal pa'i dam chos kun 'dzin tsong kha pa/ /mgon de'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad paṇa chen rje/ /zla med bla ma gsum la gsol ba =/ /legs spyad smon lam dag pa'i 'tsham sbyar gyis/ /yongs su grags pa'i mdo sngags chos tshul kun/ /bshaṃd dang sgruṃb pa'i sgo nas 'dzin brtson pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la =/ /khyad par rgyal ba gnyis par rab grags pa'i/ /legs bshad sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod cing*/ / gzhan la spel pa'i thugs bskyed brtan gyur pa/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la =/ /yi ge'i sbyor dang snyan ngag rtsis la sogs/ /rig gnas mang dang mdo rgyud man ngag gis/ /chos tshul kun la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /mkhas pa'i phul byung khyod la =/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo la sogs lhag pa'i lhas/ /byin gyis brlabs pas gzhung lugs sna tshogs pa'i/ /legs bshad spel te 'gro ba phan brtson pa/ /gzhan don lhur mdzad khyod la =/ /mchog gsum yi dam mkha' 'gro bstan srung dang*/ /rten 'brel mi bslu lhag bsam dag pa'i stobs/ / bstan pa'i dpal gyur yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes/ /bskal pa'i bar du yon ring zhabs brtan shog /skye ba kun tu zhes kyang brjod bar bya'o/ ces pa 'di yang*/ khri zur sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas nyid kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad bdun tsam yod pa zhig gyis shig ces bskul ba'i tshe/ rtsom 'dod ma byung yang bskul ba po'i gsung bzlog ma nus par g.yar khral du sbyar ro// // na mo shākya mu na ye/ mnyam med thub dbang mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /klu sgrub thogs med rje btsun tsong kha pa*/ /paṇa chen rgyal dbang snga phyir byon la sogs/

/dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba gnyis par grags pas rjes bzung pas/ /mgon de'i chos tshul bshad sgrub rnam gnyis kyis/ /ji bzhin 'dzin pa'i blo gros rtsal ldan pa/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /mkha' 'gro bstan srung chos dbyings bden pa'i mthus/ /bstan pa'i dpal gyur yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes/ /bskal brgyar zhabs pad yun ring brtan gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ ces pa 'di yang*/ blo bzang don grub sogs gzhan bu slob 'ga' zhig gis nan cher bskul ba ltar kī ti'i ming can gyis bris so/ /madga laṃ// //༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ /bde ba'i mchog gyur lhan skyes gcig pu nyid/ /dam tshig sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /rab 'byams 'khor lo lnga yi lha tshogs su/ /sprul mdzad he ru ka dpal zhabs la 'dud/ /gdul bya'i rgyud la lhan skyes bde ba che/ /rgyas par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa ni/ /bsgrub phyir nyid sku yid 'phrog mdzes ma'i skur/ /sprul ba'i rje btsun ma yis rtag tu skyongs/ /gsang pa kun 'dzin rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag /grub mchog sa ra ha dang lū hi pa/ /dā ri ka dang dril bu'i zhabs la sogs/ /grub chen bla ma rnams la=/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /de sras thu po mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /lam 'di srol 'dzin zla med chos kyi rje/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhabs la=/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug du mas bgrod gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyis tshul bzhin 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la=/

/mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge dang*/ /de sras thu bo kun dga' don grub sogs/ /'dus pa'i dbang bskur bshad srol man ngag gi/ /dngos rgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /legs bshad dbyar rnga dang pa'i dbyu gu yis/ /legs bskul grags pa'i sgra dbyangs cher sgrogs pa/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par rgyud sde stong phrag so gsum dang*/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi rtsa/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgyas btab rgyud kyi rgyal/ /'dzin mdzad rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang/ /'bral med chos kyi dpal longs sbyod cing*/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myug thob shog /madga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bstod tshogs kyi skor bzhugs/ -PAGE 348--PAGE 349--PAGE 346-
